items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1967-10-28
items.q: Because that, Mr. Big gives you that. And he gave it to them.

ctx.x: It was, the spirit was the same. You, there's no white man in the world will ever capture the rhythm. A lot of us, a lot of us have come close, but there's no white man in the world will ever capture. Because that, Mr. Big gives you that. And he gave it to them.
Do you remember Jelly Roll Morton?
